material_delta.summary: Adds a generic repository gate that rejects nonexistent source-proof blobs and valid blobs that do not match the declared path at material_head_sha.

fullstack_http_browser.assertion: Vite/browser/JWT/Express/domain/Prisma/PostgreSQL cross a real internal path without internal seam mocks.

flow_postgresql.assertion: Creation/reuse, completion, approval, rejection and contract isolation use real PostgreSQL.

notification_delivery.assertion: Accepted/sent/failed states, disabled channels and concurrency are discriminated at the external-provider boundary.

contract_boundary.assertion: Ambiguous or revoked contract context is denied before protected profile-review behavior.

temporal_guard_regression.assertion: Past, current boundary, coherent future and outside-operational-week cases remain covered.

public_error_temporal_remediation.assertion: PB-ERR-001 reaches the real service/database rollback path with fixed RELEASE_NOW.

source_proof_validator.assertion: Every current source_proof git_blob_sha must exist as a blob and equal material_head_sha:path.

source_proof_validator_tests.assertion: Fixtures distinguish exact match, existing wrong-path blob and nonexistent blob.

validate_command_integration.assertion: pnpm validate includes the audit:source-proofs gate.

provenance_rebind.reason: All declared source_proofs now use the exact blob SHA resolved for their path on the current material head, and the repository validator rejects both nonexistent and valid-but-wrong-path blobs.
